# glinet_system_led (Resource)

Manage one OpenWrt `system` LED section. The UCI section name is the stable identity.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) UCI LED section name.
- `sysfs` (String) LED sysfs device name.

### Optional

- `default` (String) Default LED state.
- `delayoff` (String) Delay-off interval.
- `delayon` (String) Delay-on interval.
- `delete_behavior` (String) Destroy behavior. `forget` releases Terraform ownership and preserves the UCI section; `delete` removes a Terraform-created named section. Firmware-owned anonymous sections are always preserved.
- `dev` (String) Network device for the trigger.
- `mode` (String) Trigger mode.
- `trigger` (String) LED trigger.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable import identifier.
- `owner` (String) Owner token recorded with the router section. It detects another Terraform state that manages the same section.
- `uci_section` (String) Resolved UCI section name on the router.
